history.sentence: Nia wanted to water a sunflower, but Nia noticed that tomato seedlings were thirsty, and Mr Bell explained that a tap was broken.
Nia borrowed a blue watering can from Mr Bell.
She filled the watering can from a rain barrel.
She watered the tomato seedlings with the watering can.
Shade cloth fell, and the tomato seedlings were exposed.
Nia opened a yellow umbrella above the tomato seedlings.
She fetched a garden tie from the drawer, and she secured the umbrella in a heavy pot with the garden tie.
Mrs Okafor arrived with a clip.
Nia and Mrs Okafor repaired the shade cloth with the clip.
Nia filled the watering can from the tap.
Nia watered the sunflower with the watering can.
Nia returned the watering can to Mr Bell.
The tomato seedlings stood under the repaired shade cloth.
